title: Concept: Spring Actuator index disclosed in a response
description: The Actuator discovery document maps every management endpoint the application exposes and links to each one. Publishing that index converts a blind endpoint search into a list of live read paths for health, metrics and configuration data.
applicability: Responses served by Spring Boot with the management endpoints enabled.
risk: The full management surface is enumerated for the reader; MEDIUM severity because each listed endpoint may expose more sensitive data.
